verses.1: And Jehovah saw him at Elon Mamre. And he sat at the entrance of the tent that day.
verses.2: He raised his eyes and saw that there were three men standing over him. He rushed towards them from the entrance of the tent, and he bowed down to them.
verses.3: And he said, “O Lord, if I have indeed pleased you, then please do not reject your servant.”
verses.4: Please get some water. Wash your feet with it, and rest under the tree.
verses.5: And I will take some bread and give it to you to eat after you have passed through these places. For thus, as you pass through them, so will it be. They said, “Do as you have said.”
verses.6: And Abraham hurried to Sarah’s house. He said, “Hurry up! Make three bags of grain for me, and also prepare some food for us.”
verses.7: And in the morning, Abraham ran away. He took a kind and good child with him. He gave it to the boy, and rushed to do what needed to be done.
verses.8: And he took honey and milk, along with the morning bird that he had caught. He offered them before them. Then he stood under the tree, and they ate from it.
verses.9: And they said to her, “Who is your husband?” She replied, “Look, he is here.”
verses.10: And he said, “I will come to you again. Now, there’s a son for your wife. And your wife will hear the sound of the door opening. He will be next to her.”
verses.11: And Abraham and Sarah, who were old men, began to live like ordinary people. They no longer lived as gods.
verses.12: And the priest laughed in his anger, saying, “After my wife, there will be another woman for me. My wife will become old.”
verses.13: And Jehovah said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh? She said, ‘They are all dead, and I am old.’”
verses.14: May the words of Jehovah be fulfilled for me, when I return to you again. May I live and have sons with you.
verses.15: And Sarah said, “I didn’t laugh, because I was afraid.” But he replied, “You did laugh.”
verses.16: And those men got up from there. They looked towards Sodom. And Abraham went with them to destroy it.
verses.17: And Jehovah said, “The one who covers me is I, Abraham. I am the one who does this.”
verses.18: And Abraham will become a great and powerful nation. All the nations of the earth will be blessed through him.
verses.19: For they knew that it was necessary for their children and their descendants to follow his commands. They also knew that they must keep the ways of Jehovah, and act with righteousness and justice. This was so that Jehovah could bring about what he had promised about Abraham.
verses.20: And the LORD said, “The cries of Sodom and Gomorrah are great, and their sins are numerous. They have become desolate.”
verses.21: Please come down and I will see the cry that came to me. They have done everything they could, but if I don’t know…
verses.22: And those men turned around from there. They went away, while Abraham still stood before Jehovah.
verses.23: And Abraham went and said, “May the righteous be reconciled with the wicked.”
verses.24: But there are fifty righteous people inside the city of Af-Tsseh. They won’t be able to escape to another place, because those fifty righteous people are also trapped within the city.
verses.25: May this act of killing the righteous along with the wicked be cursed upon you. May it be like the case where the righteous become like the wicked. May this judgment over the entire earth be cursed upon you; no one shall judge in accordance with justice.
verses.26: And the LORD said, “If I find fifty righteous people within the city, then I will bring them out and place them in every place.”
verses.27: And Abraham said, “Please, let me speak to my Lord. I am Afer and Efer.”
verses.28: But if there are fifty righteous people, then five of them will be allowed to destroy the entire city. But he said, “I will not destroy it unless I find forty-five people there.”
verses.29: And he continued to speak to him. He said, “If there are forty of them there, I will not do anything about them.”
verses.30: And he said, “Please, let my master speak with me.” But if they find thirty people there, he said, “I won’t do it, even if I find thirty people there.”
verses.31: And he said, “Now, please, let me speak to my master. But if there are forty people there, then I will not do it.”
verses.32: And he said, “Please, let me speak to the Lord. But this time, I hope they will find ten people there.” And he said, “I will not destroy them because of those ten people.”
verses.33: And Jehovah went away, as He had decided to speak to Abraham. And Abraham returned to his place.
